beats.text: After PokerKT sacrifices his own Censer of Restful Peace, RubyXillia brings out another to keep floating memory locked.
PokerKT uses Glimmering Refusal to stop Avatar of Suzaku, then Zhang Jiao restores life.
Portentous Tanggu and Fabled Ruby Fatestone complete Suzaku’s quest; Suzaku’s Command and Peppered Chef close the game.
Fiery Interference denies Zhang Jiao’s recovery and brings RubyXillia closer to Suzaku.
Crystalline Mirror removes Viridian Protective Trinket, allowing Aenean Frozen Shunt to stop Avatar of Suzaku’s attack.
After forcing Safeguard Amulet, PokerKT fires more damage and uses Frostbind from memory to stop Restorative Flame.
Convergent Beam targets Avatar of Suzaku; RubyXillia gives up the ally for quest counters instead.
Zhang Jiao draws two cards for PokerKT, giving him more resources for the final exchanges.
Nullifying Lantern shuts off RubyXillia’s fire graveyard synergies before PokerKT starts firing damage.

PokerKT stacks Refracting Missile and Shimmering Refraction before Safeguard Amulet resolves. RubyXillia answers with Shatter the Brittle and Restorative Flame, but Glimmering Refusal seals the title.
